name: Belfast

neighborhoods.name: Queen's Quarter
neighborhoods.homes: Victorian terraces and shared student houses

housing: Belfast's rentals are largely red-brick terraced houses, many shared by students near Queen's, plus modern apartments in the city centre and Titanic Quarter.

localRules.text: In Northern Ireland the landlord must protect the deposit in an approved scheme within 28 days and give the tenant the scheme information within 35 days.
Private landlords in Northern Ireland must join the Landlord Registration Scheme, and tenants can check a landlord on nidirect.

tenantHelp.name: Housing Rights
tenantHelp.what: free housing advice in Northern Ireland, including deposit disputes

tenantHelp.name: nidirect
tenantHelp.what: government guidance on deposits for tenants

climate: Belfast is mild and wet, so photograph any damp or mould and test the heating and hot water.
fact: The Holylands near Queen's University is one of the densest student renting areas in the UK.
